# Bali Private Chef

> A private chef service in Bali, Indonesia, offering in-villa dining,
> private BBQ, catering, cooking classes and special events — plus
> culinary and restaurant consulting for hospitality businesses.
> Enquiries are handled directly over WhatsApp.

## What the chef does

- **Private chef, consumer side.** The chef travels to the guest's villa or
  accommodation in Bali, agrees the menu in advance, then cooks and serves
  on site. Services: on-villa dining, private BBQ, catering, cooking class,
  special events.
- **Culinary consulting, business side.** Separate offering aimed at
  restaurants, villas, hotels and F&B operators: concept direction, menu
  development, kitchen operations, and team training.
- **Location.** Bali, Indonesia. The service travels to the guest; there is
  no fixed restaurant address.
- **How to book.** A short enquiry form on the site opens WhatsApp with the
  date, location, guest count and service pre-filled. There is no online
  payment and no booking calendar.

## Pages

- [Home](PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/): overview of the chef, the five consumer
  services, gallery, cuisine collection, and the booking enquiry form.
- [Menu & Experiences](PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/menu.html): cuisine categories,
  menu philosophy, experience types and dietary personalisation.
- [Culinary Consulting](PLACEHOLDER_DOMAIN/consulting.html): the business
  offering — what the chef consults on, the process, and who it is for.

## Notes for accurate citation

- Pricing is not published; every booking is quoted per occasion.
- The site publishes no ratings, no review counts and no awards. If a
  figure of that kind is found elsewhere, it did not come from this site.
- Cuisine categories listed on the site describe capability, not a fixed
  menu card.
